previous_last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now keeps STEP/DIR idle stepper drivers enabled between steps, waits a fixed 2 ms after enabling before the first STEP edge, and releases the driver after five seconds without movement or when main-relay power or battery voltage is unavailable. The idle hardware page documents the new timing and power-loss behavior.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU changes STEP/DIR idle stepper behavior. The driver enable output now stays asserted between steps instead of being released after every pulse, a fixed 2 ms settle delay follows each enable before the first STEP edge, and the driver is released after five seconds without movement. The driver is also released, and no step is taken, when main-relay power is off or battery voltage is below the minimum stepper voltage, including during the 2 ms enable delay. No tune fields or calibration layout change, so no tune migration is needed. Verify the enable polarity and wiring for the installed board, and confirm the minimum stepper voltage setting matches the hardware before relying on the power-loss release.

last_sync.summary: Both commits in this range are CI-only changes to the Unit Tests workflow. The extra cylinder fuel trim build jobs now run on master pushes, manual dispatches, and pull requests that touch trim-related files, instead of on every push and pull request. No firmware behavior, tune layout, flashing procedure, or builder workflow changes, so no wiki page needs an update.

decisions.rationale: Maintainer-only CI change. The Unit Tests workflow gains a changes job that decides whether the extra cylinder fuel trim jobs run, and the two trim jobs now depend on it. This affects only when automated test builds execute; firmware behavior, calibration layout, flashing, and build inputs are unchanged, so no reader-facing documentation needs revision.
evidence: `cylinder-fuel-trim` and `cylinder-fuel-trim-arm` jobs gain `needs: changes` and `if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.run_trim == 'true' }}`
Trigger changed from `on: [push,pull_request]` to push/pull_request/workflow_dispatch; no firmware source paths touched
